restaurantName: Rotunda Bar & Lounge at Four Seasons Ten Trinity Square
bio: Presiding at the heart of the Four Seasons Hotel London at Ten Trinity Square, Rotunda Bar and Lounge is a stylish and elegant venue set beneath an art deco domed ceiling, serving an all-day dining menu from breakfast, light lunches, Afternoon Tea to refined evening meals.  The Crown Jewels Afternoon Tea is inspired by the treasures of our neighbours at the Tower of London. Kings and Queens of England have stored crowns, robes, and other items of their ceremonial regalia at the historical landmark for over 600 years.  In the evenings the Rotunda transforms into a relaxed, yet sophisticated cocktail bar, where the bartender's creations take centre stage. Perfect for after work drinks, pre-dinner aperitivo or a nightcap, the bar offers an impressive menu of creative cocktails, refined classics and rare vintage spirits.  Rotunda Bar and Lounge is located in the Four Seasons Hotel London at Ten Trinity Square, which is in the heart of London. The nearest station is Tower Hill.
